_meta.notes: Seed archetypes chosen in the spawn scene. Four playable seeds, each a set of multipliers applied through Plant traits; the shared resolver and the server both read this list. Descriptions are player-facing.

value.name: Verdant
value.description: A balanced seed. Even roots, even shoot, no bad season.

value.name: Deeproot
value.description: Slow above the soil, thirsty below it. Roots hold more water and reach farther.

value.name: Sunspire
value.description: Built for full light. Fast carbon, thin reserves, little patience for shade.

value.name: Stoneheart
value.description: Hardy and mineral-hungry. Leans on stored stone and survives lean weather.

definitions.notes: The first entry is the default when an old client sends no archetype.
